changelog:
Initial release of sheet-to-doc-skill: Generate Word documents from templates and JSON data.

- Generate Word (.docx) documents by replacing `{field}` placeholders with JSON data.
- Extract all placeholders from a template for data schema validation and error debugging.
- Automatically adds a footer mark to generated documents.
- Supports batch generation, mail-merge scenarios, and standard document automation.
- Provides clear examples and API references for easy integration.
- Requires Node.js 18+, docxtemplater, and pizzip.
summary: Generate Word documents from Word templates and JSON data. Supports basic placeholder replacement ({field} format) and placeholder extraction for data validation. Best for batch-generating contracts, invitations, certificates, and mail-merge style docs.
